title_zh: 中央军委后勤保障部等六部门发布通告：禁止涉军队退役报废装备销售活动
title_en: Six Central Military Commission Departments Ban Sale of Retired and Scrapped Military Equipment
summary_zh: 中央军委后勤保障部、装备发展部等六部门联合发布通告，禁止涉军队退役报废装备的销售活动。
summary_en: Six departments under the Central Military Commission jointly issued a notice banning the sale of retired and scrapped military equipment.
